summary:
The Prohibiting Russian Uranium Imports Act (Pub. L. 118-62, H.R. 1042, enacted May 13, 2024) prohibits importation into the United States of unirradiated low-enriched uranium (LEU) produced in the Russian Federation or by a Russian entity. Its operative mechanism is the amendment of Section 3112A of the USEC Privatization Act (42 U.S.C. 2297h-10a) by adding a new subsection (d).

Section 2(a) adds subsection (d)(1), imposing the import prohibition beginning 90 days after enactment. The prohibition covers both Russian-produced LEU (subparagraph (A)) and LEU determined to have been exchanged, swapped, or otherwise obtained in lieu of Russian LEU to circumvent the restriction (subparagraph (B)).

New paragraph (d)(2) authorizes the Secretary of Energy, in consultation with the Secretaries of State and Commerce, to waive the prohibition upon determining either that no alternative viable source of LEU is available to sustain a nuclear reactor or U.S. nuclear energy company, or that importation is in the national interest. Waivers are subject to annual import ceilings (measured in kilograms): 476,536 (2024), 470,376 (2025), 464,183 (2026), and 459,083 (2027). The Secretary of Commerce administers these limits consistent with the Suspension Agreement (referencing subsection (c)(2)(B)(i)), enforces them, and must do so with minimal burden on the commercial nuclear industry. Any waiver terminates not later than January 1, 2028 (subparagraph (C)). Issuance of a waiver triggers a notification requirement to the Senate Committees on Energy and Natural Resources and Finance and the House Committees on Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means, including identification of the waiver recipient.

Paragraph (d)(3) exempts imports by or under contract to the Department of Energy for national security or nonproliferation purposes, and imports of non-uranium isotopes. Paragraph (d)(4) provides that the subsection terminates December 31, 2040. Paragraph (d)(5) defines "Russian entity" as an entity organized under, or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction of, the Government of the Russian Federation.

Section 2(b) makes conforming amendments to Section 3112A(c). Paragraph (1) strikes clauses (xi) through (xxvii) of subsection (c)(2)(A), strikes paragraph (5), redesignates paragraphs (6)–(12) as (5)–(11), and makes corresponding cross-reference corrections (including replacing "paragraph (10)" with "paragraph (9)," and revising the paragraph (8) termination reference from "December 31, 2040" to "the date described in subsection (d)(1)"). Paragraph (2) provides that the amendment striking subsection (c)(2)(A)(xi) takes effect 90 days after enactment.

The Act contains no appropriations.
